findings.claim: ADR-0016's per-agent table states as settled fact that Case A (hook fires for a subagent's MCP tool call) is 'yes' for ZCode. But the project's own evidence for ZCode marks exactly this as unverified, and TECH-SPEC/README still list it as an open live-check item (G25/GS3). ADR-0016 is presenting an open question as a decided fact.
findings.evidence: ADR-0016:42 'VS Code, ZCode | yes | rewrite supported | no output replacement: ...'. tickets/spike-hooks-verified.md line with ZCode row: 'PreToolUse | additionalContext | permissionDecision / exit 2 | UNKNOWN | - | DOCS (+#1268)'; same file, section 4: 'MCP firing: Copilot CLI, agy, ZCode, OpenCode 2 (codemode), Pi (no native MCP)' listed under 'Remaining unknowns'; and 'Full contract: Claude Code, Codex, Qwen, ZCode (MCP pending), Kiro (pending live)'. docs/v2/TECH-SPEC.md:36 'GS3 | G25 is answered: do hooks fire for MCP tools on Copilot CLI, ZCode, Pi and OpenCode 2 (GP-LIVE-HOOKS) | release job' and docs/v2/README.md:75 '[O] G25: whether hooks fire for MCP tools in Copilot CLI, ZCode, Pi and OpenCode 2. This needs a real model turn.'
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: ZCode has no v1 history to check — it is a new adapter, requested in issue #1268 ('Native ZCode adapter', tickets/v2-issue-map.md:18, status Q, 'D14 says requested new adapters are separate scope decisions'). ADR-0011:71 confirms this directly: 'ZCode | none | —' is the only v1-footprint row with no entry, because v1 never shipped a ZCode adapter. ORIGINAL_INTENT: ADR-0016 Case A 'yes' is a forward guess, not an observed result — the only source document for ZCode's hook behavior (spike-hooks-verified.md) tags every ZCode row 'DOCS' (read from zcode.z.ai docs, not run) and explicitly places MCP-tool firing in 'Remaining unknowns'. REGRESSION_RISK: none against v1 (nothing to regress), but shipping ADR-0016's subagent-protection design for ZCode on the unverified assumption that hooks fire for MCP tools means the real gap — if ZCode turns out not to fire PreToolUse for MCP calls — is that case C's fallback-to-deny path (the MUST-16 'large output never enters subagent context' guarantee) silently never engages, and a subagent's unbounded MCP output reaches context on ZCode with no warning anywhere in the docs. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: do not harden this by adding a fallback chain (owner decision: no fallback chains). Instead mark ZCode Case A as '[U], pending GP-LIVE-HOOKS' in the same row, and make the ADR-0012 release harness's G25 check a release gate for ZCode specifically, not just a background open item.
findings.fix: Change ADR-0016:42 to mark ZCode's Case A as unverified ('[U], pending G25/GP-LIVE-HOOKS'), matching its own PreToolUse/MCP-firing row in spike-hooks-verified.md, and cross-reference GS3 so a reader does not take the subagent-protection design as proven for ZCode before the live check runs.

findings.claim: TECH-SPEC's distribution table gives ZCode a specific install/launch command and project-source rule ('zcode --prompt --output-format stream-json', 'project-root zcode.json; no published Linux CLI, build apps/zcode-cli') with no live check and no agent source to check it against — the agent-sources folder for this review round has no ZCode checkout at all, unlike gemini-cli, qwen-code, opencode and pi-mono which do.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/TECH-SPEC.md:369 '| ZCode | tier 2 | `zcode --prompt --output-format stream-json` | ZCode credential | project-root `zcode.json`; no published Linux CLI, build `apps/zcode-cli` |'; docs/v2/TECH-SPEC.md:82 '**[U] no evidence.** Code search in public `zai-org/ZCode`: `getInstructions` 0 hits ...'; spike-hooks-verified.md ZCode row ends 'Live: not possible'. Directory listing of the review's agent-sources scratchpad (gemini-cli, qwen-code, opencode, badlogic_pi-mono) has no zcode entry.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: no v1 commit touches ZCode (confirmed: ADR-0011:71 'ZCode | none | —'; issue #1268 is the first request for this adapter and is still status Q in tickets/v2-issue-map.md:18). There is no prior fix to regress, so this is a pure net-new-adapter risk, not a reopened bug. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: the owner's 'no fallback chains' and 'no npm for v2' rules both bite here — 'build apps/zcode-cli' is the only path TECH-SPEC gives when there's no published Linux CLI, so it cannot be hedged with a secondary install path if the build step is wrong; it has to be gotten right or explicitly scoped out before release.
findings.fix: Add S-ZCODE (already listed in TECH-SPEC:396 as a planned spike, but not yet run) as a release-blocking spike, not an optional one: pull the real zai-org/ZCode source once (not just GitHub code search) and verify the stream-json flag, the zcode.json project-source rule and the apps/zcode-cli build step before TECH-SPEC:369 is treated as release-ready. Until then, tag the whole row [U] in the table itself, not only in the scattered C3/Q10/S-ZCODE notes.
